evidence: The rustic charm of the rế tre, a traditional bamboo tray lined with oil-absorbing paper, is a distinctive feature of the bánh tôm, adding to its appeal and authenticity. Visually, each bánh tôm is a delightful sight, characterized by its domed, oval shape and a golden, crispy exterior formed from a batter mixed with shredded sweet potatoes.
